original_card.question: Can one measured replay bottleneck be sped up without dropping coverage?
methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Report before/after wall time on the same fixture, retained checks and invalidation behavior.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected reproduction command and choose a single replay stage for profiling.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Measure one unchanged fixture, preserve check coverage, and test one optimization with invalidation controls.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Faster trustworthy replays increase review throughput and let mechanism candidates be checked sooner.
allowed_variations: Profile one stage or design one source-bound cache boundary.
scope_change_triggers: Skipping coverage or comparing different fixtures to claim speedup.

actual_scope: Reduce the memory used by exact reduced-triple equivalence classes without changing keys, enumerated triples, relators or the complete retained Fano replay. Measure original and compact storage both with canonical multiplication and with the separately pinned row-table engine.
scope_change_reason: The obvious row-product runtime optimization is already supplied by Charan/PR3219. Both implementations still allocate a list and tuple for nearly 1.38 million singleton classes. This distinct measured refinement targets peak process memory, and reports wall time rather than presuming a speedup.
bottleneck_link: Smaller exact replay processes reduce resource pressure when reviewers run independent checks concurrently. The same source checks, complete census, Fano searches and semantic controls remain mandatory.
stop_rule: Within about 60 minutes, require complete receipt and full-census equality, meaningful independent controls and a substantial fresh-process memory reduction. Stop if storage loses any member, measured savings are negligible, or exact source binding cannot be retained. Do not extend the mathematical search or promote a supplier.
evidence: The complete registered CPython 3.12.15 replay passes: all four full verifier modes reproduce the original 806-byte receipt and the same full-census digest, and all 17 isolated optimized controls pass with warnings treated as errors. Independent controls also pass normally. Sixteen fresh processes in four alternating repetitions measured mean peak RSS reductions of 42.97% for canonical multiplication (401817 to 229169 KiB) and 44.40% with pinned row tables (389445 to 216519 KiB). Mean wall times were 29.119 to 27.966 seconds and 11.650 to 10.322 seconds; timing ranges overlap for the row-table pair, so no portable speed or significance claim is made. All raw samples, commands, receipts and 13 unchanged code/input hashes are retained. No selected cold replay, native/all-width proof, new mathematical theorem, supplier admission or independent human review.
author: thakrarsagar with OpenAI Codex
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in design, implementation, independently written dense-oracle controls, benchmark methodology, source review and writing. Separate AI executions are not independent human review.

open_questions.why_it_matters: The transformations address different costs and may jointly reduce time and memory while preserving the complete fixture.
